title: FlexLine Repayment Term by Balance and Line Age
content:
When a FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit line is closed to new draws while a balance remains, the term over which that balance is repaid follows the balance being repaid and the age of the line from its open date.

## Rule

A balance of 3000.00 USD or less on a line open fewer than 24 months is repaid over 18 months; a balance of 3000.00 USD or less on a line open 24 months or more is repaid over 24 months; any other balance is repaid over the tier's repayment period.

The balance being repaid is the outstanding balance on the closing date, the amount past due included. The age of the line is counted in whole calendar months from the open date to the closing date, a month counting only once the closing date's day of the month reaches the open date's day of the month.

| Balance being repaid | Line open | Term |
|---|---|---|
| 3000.00 USD or less | fewer than 24 whole calendar months | 18 months |
| 3000.00 USD or less | 24 whole calendar months or more | 24 months |
| above 3000.00 USD | any age | the tier's repayment period |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- A balance of exactly 3000.00 USD is "3000.00 or less"; 3000.01 USD is not.
- A line opened on 20 May and closed on 19 May two years later is 23 whole months old (the 19th has not reached the 20th), so a 2500.00 USD balance is repaid over 18 months; closed on 20 May two years later, it is 24 months old and the same balance is repaid over 24 months.
- A line opened on 31 January is 0 whole months old on 28 February (the 28th has not reached the 31st) and 2 whole months old on 31 March.
